searchText: Hello. I am still investigating why blobscan is not indexing any blobs atm. In devnet6 we moved from lighthouse to lodestar and apparently the endpoints are different. Could you help me understanding why the endpoint to retrieve blobs in lodestar is `/eth/v1/beacon/blob_sidecars/<block_id>` while in lighthouse is `/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/<blob_id>`? Are they the correct endpoints to query? I think the API says it should be: `/eth/v1/beacon/blob_sidecars/{block_id}` (https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=v2.4.1), so the lh one must be wrong? <@491624610215886849> <@607055410104500244> Right! Thanks, working on a fix! just merged a fix into this branch https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/tree/deneb-free-blobs

excerpts.author: trimetilo
excerpts.content:
Hello. I am still investigating why blobscan is not indexing any blobs atm.

In devnet6 we moved from lighthouse to lodestar and apparently the endpoints are different.
Could you help me understanding why the endpoint to retrieve blobs in lodestar is `/eth/v1/beacon/blob_sidecars/<block_id>` while in lighthouse is `/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/<blob_id>`? Are they the correct endpoints to query?

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: I think the API says it should be: `/eth/v1/beacon/blob_sidecars/{block_id}` (https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=v2.4.1), so the lh one must be wrong? <@491624610215886849> <@607055410104500244>

excerpts.author: realbigsean
excerpts.content: Right! Thanks, working on a fix!

excerpts.author: realbigsean
excerpts.content: just merged a fix into this branch https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/tree/deneb-free-blobs
